text: Imagine being the security guy for McDonald's Monopoly, and stealing almost every big prize for years.
Jerome Jacobson did. He opened the envelopes, swapped the winners, and resealed them.
Then he sold the pieces to fake winners for a cut.
More than thirteen million dollars, per the F B I. Later counts, over twenty-four million.
The trial started September tenth, two thousand one. Worst possible timing.
More than fifty convicted. He got thirty-seven months.
